articles.title: Strive’s SATA nears $1 billion market cap as Strategy’s STRC continues to underperform
articles.snippet: SATA’s 13% annualised dividend and resilience around par are helping Strive raise capital and outperform Strategy.

articles.title: Visa combines VisaNet data with onchain lending to power stablecoin card working capital
articles.snippet: Visa's stablecoin settlement volume surpassed a $20 billion annualized run rate, up 15x year over year. Now it wants blockchain lenders to use that data to extend credit to the issuers driving the growth.

articles.title: Uzbekistan begins government bond-backed stablecoin payment pilot
articles.snippet: Humo Digital will test HUMO payments with more than 20 merchants under a sandbox jointly overseen by NAPP and Uzbekistan’s central bank.

articles.title: Capital B adds 376 Bitcoin in $29M purchase, boosting holdings to 3,521 BTC
articles.snippet: Capital B’s latest Bitcoin purchase was its largest in nearly a year, pushing the French company ahead of H100 Group among publicly traded BTC holders.

articles.title: Yen intervention meets US inflation data: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.snippet: This week’s CPI and PPI prints, along with the Fed’s Sept. 16 rate decision, could determine whether Bitcoin can secure $80,000 as a support level.
